Map of Georgia — attractions and road trips

82 places across 11 regions. For each one we list how long you need on site, how far it is from Tbilisi, what the road is like and which car category you will need.

Click a marker for details. Coloured lines are ready-made road trips.

Road trips

Moderate

Georgian Military Highway and Kazbegi

Two days on Georgia's great mountain road — Zhinvali, Ananuri, Gudauri and Gergeti Trinity.

2 days · 340 km · Crossover / SUV
Easy

Kakheti Wine Loop

Three days across the Alazani valley: Sighnaghi, Bodbe, Telavi, Tsinandali, Alaverdi and Kvareli.

3 days · 420 km · Economy class
Moderate

Vardzia and Borjomi — the Southern Route

Two days in Samtskhe-Javakheti: Borjomi park, Rabati castle, Khertvisi and the cave city of Vardzia.

2 days · 550 km · Economy class
Moderate

Imereti: Caves and Canyons

Three days in western Georgia: Uplistsikhe, Kutaisi, Gelati, Prometheus, Sataplia and Okatse.

3 days · 640 km · Crossover / SUV
Hard

Svaneti Expedition

Five days in Upper Svaneti: Kutaisi, Zugdidi, the Enguri dam, Mestia and Ushguli.

5 days · 1050 km · Off-road 4x4
Moderate

Black Sea and Adjara

Four days in the west: Kutaisi, Kobuleti, Batumi, Gonio, Makhuntseti and Mtirala.

4 days · 880 km · Crossover / SUV
Moderate

Racha Mountain Loop

Three days in Racha: Kutaisi, Tkibuli, Nikortsminda, Ambrolauri, Shaori and Oni.

3 days · 790 km · Crossover / SUV

Regions

Tbilisi

Georgia's capital in a narrow valley on the Mtkvari — old town, sulphur baths and the starting point of almost every route.

8 places

Mtskheta-Mtianeti

The ancient capital Mtskheta and the Georgian Military Highway to Kazbegi — history and high mountains on one axis.

9 places

Kakheti

Georgia's wine country on the Alazani Valley — cellars, ancient churches, the hill town of Sighnaghi and the Tusheti mountains.

12 places

Kvemo Kartli

South of Tbilisi — very early churches, the Dmanisi excavations and Dashbashi Canyon, all within day-trip range.

5 places

Shida Kartli

Uplistsikhe, Gori and orchards on the Mtkvari plain — the simplest day trip west of Tbilisi.

5 places

Samtskhe-Javakheti

Borjomi forests, the rock city of Vardzia and the high Javakheti plateau with its lakes — two climates in one region.

8 places

Imereti

Kutaisi, Gelati and a karst landscape — caves, canyons and waterfalls within an hour of each other.

9 places

Racha-Lechkhumi

Georgia's quietest mountain corner — Khvanchkara vineyards, Nikortsminda and the high valleys above Oni.

5 places

Samegrelo-Zemo Svaneti

Subtropical Samegrelo with its canyons and Upper Svaneti with its towers — one region, two entirely different worlds.

9 places

Guria

Tea plantations between the sea and the mountains — the magnetic sand of Ureki and the high resort of Bakhmaro.

4 places

Adjara

Batumi, the Black Sea coast and the mountains of Upper Adjara — Georgia's wettest and greenest corner.

8 places
